Off by default. When enabled, HookLab sends rate-limited event codes for MCC, Neo Store and Droid-ify to LSPosed logs via libxposed. No account details, app-page data, repository URLs, credentials or exception messages. Restart the target apps after changing this setting to reliably refresh framework preferences.

Hooked processes cannot write libxposed remote preferences. Runtime outcomes are reported as sanitized events in LSPosed logs, not stored here. An installer failure prevents another attempt in the same host process, but cannot automatically lock future processes. The module app can set persistent manual safety locks. No app content or exception messages are logged. Restart the host app after changing a lock.
Block this tweak on the next host process start? This does not change the opt-in preference or restart the host app.

No imported diagnostics available. This is not evidence that hooks did or did not run.

Navigation only. These buttons never enable hooks or grant scope.
Explicit file-import session only. This does not capture live logs, inspect app internals, enable hooks, or establish actual runtime execution.
Choose one target and one allowed imported-log source; capture runs for up to 10 minutes. Import a log file after reproducing the behavior. Raw lines are discarded by the DX-01 sanitizer.
